result.rationale: The diff shows the handler calls appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body) and symmetricDecrypt(...)/JSON.parse(...) with no try/catch anywhere in the new webhook endpoint (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts). Zod's .parse throws a ZodError on malformed bodies and symmetricDecrypt throws on undecryptable input, so a request with a valid secret but invalid payload indeed results in an unhandled exception/500 rather than a descriptive 4xx. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff and describes degraded error-handling behavior introduced by this change.

judged_text: appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body), symmetricDecrypt, and JSON.parse all throw on malformed or wrongly-encrypted payloads with no try/catch, so a request with a valid secret but an invalid or undecryptable body returns a 500 instead of a 4xx. Any malformed webhook delivery or parent/child encryption-key mismatch produces unhandled 500s (with stack traces in dev) instead of a descriptive 400, and retrying senders hammer the endpoint with non-actionable failures.
